alternate_names: Sri Sri Radha Madhav Sundar Mandir

history.summary: The ISKCON temple of Siliguri, Sri Sri Radha Madhav Sundar Mandir, at Gitalpara, ISKCON Temple Road, Siliguri 734006 - the biggest Krishna centre in Northeast India, dedicated to Lord Krishna as Radha Madhav. Built in a modern architectural style retaining traditional Indian Vaishnava customs, it houses idols of Radha Madhav, Panchatattva, Advaita Acharya, Narasimha and Chaitanya Mahaprabhu, with an auditorium, Govinda's restaurant and guest house on the campus. Coordinates are from the temple's official site. FLAG - name: the CSV spells it 'ISCON Temple'; documented as ISKCON Siliguri / Sri Sri Radha Madhav Sundar Mandir.

name: ISKCON Temple
town_description: Siliguri is the gateway city of North Bengal, sitting on the narrow Siliguri Corridor ('Chicken's Neck') linking mainland India with the Northeast. A busy trade and transport hub for tea, timber and tourism, it connects the plains to Darjeeling, Sikkim, Bhutan and Nepal, with Bagdogra airport and New Jalpaiguri railway station nearby.

travel.railway: New Jalpaiguri (NJP) and Siliguri Junction, ~5-8 km - verify.
travel.road: ISKCON Road, Gitalpara, Ward 41; reachable by auto-rickshaw, taxi or bus within Siliguri.

visitor_information.best_time: October to March - pleasant weather; Janmashtami draws the biggest crowds.
visitor_information.opening_hours: 8:30 AM - 8:30 PM daily (per the temple's official site). Morning 8:30 AM-1:00 PM per Justdial listing - evening session not covered there (verify).
